changelog:
v2.5.1 — Audio Fix for Movies

• Fixed movies with 5.1 surround audio (EAC3/AC3/DTS) failing on Ooustick
• Stereo downmix: 5.1/7.1 surround audio automatically converted to stereo
• FFmpeg decoder verification and diagnostic logging
• Audio Decoder status visible in Settings
• Upgraded to EXTENSION_RENDERER_MODE_PREFER for reliable FFmpeg decoding
